{"id":2073848437,"question_id":4358,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"3 days, 20 hours","timestamp":1784488105,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"40 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/2073848437/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Count Dominant Nodes in a Binary Tree","memory":"338.4 MB","code":"/**\n * Definition for a binary tree node.\n * struct TreeNode {\n *     int val;\n *     TreeNode *left;\n *     TreeNode *right;\n *     TreeNode() : val(0), left(nullptr), right(nullptr) {}\n *     TreeNode(int x) : val(x), left(nullptr), right(nullptr) {}\n *     TreeNode(int x, TreeNode *left, TreeNode *right) : val(x), left(left), right(right) {}\n * };\n */\nclass Solution {\npublic:\n    int count = 0;\n\n    int solve(TreeNode* root)\n    {\n        if(!root) return -1e9;\n\n        auto left = solve(root->left);\n        auto right = solve(root->right);\n\n        int maxi = max({root->val , left , right});\n\n        if(root->val == maxi) count++;\n        \n        return maxi;\n    }\n\n    int countDominantNodes(TreeNode* root) {\n        solve(root);\n        return count;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"count-dominant-nodes-in-a-binary-tree","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2338}
